purpose: Auditable risk disposition for live Dependabot findings. This file never dismisses or closes an alert.

entries.impact: Critical parser-differential and overwrite class; high symlink handling; medium AES HMAC bypass in the build-time archive path.
entries.mitigation: Do not dismiss. Evaluate the sherpa-onnx 2.x line, which uses zip ^9, in a pinned compatibility PR; require Windows-native compile and release checks before merge.
entries.recheckCondition: A sherpa-onnx/sherpa-onnx-sys release using zip >=9.0.5 is verified in Windows CI and the lockfile no longer resolves zip 2.x.

entries.impact: Low/medium session-key and certificate-handling issues in a transitive TLS dependency.
entries.mitigation: Keep the rustls patch PR open; it is not mergeable until the Windows native sherpa-onnx build is healthy.
entries.recheckCondition: Exact-head Windows CI passes and the lockfile resolves rustls >=0.23.46.

entries.impact: Unsound iterator behavior can produce memory-safety-adjacent undefined behavior in the upstream GTK binding chain.
entries.mitigation: Do not suppress. Track the upstream Tauri/GTK compatibility upgrade; do not force an incompatible glib major without full desktop build and runtime acceptance.
entries.recheckCondition: An upstream Tauri/GTK release supports glib >=0.20.0 and all affected desktop repositories pass native build/runtime tests.

entries.impact: Development-time denial of service through attacker-controlled glob patterns; not shipped runtime code.
entries.mitigation: Use package-manager overrides to 11.0.4+ with lint/typecheck/test/build validation; retain the Dependabot alert until resolution is re-evaluated.
entries.recheckCondition: Lockfiles resolve minimatch >=11.0.1 and the affected repositories pass their full checks.

entries.dependencyChain: Rhizomaybor web rendering/document tooling -> mermaid 11.15.0 / katex 0.16.47 / postcss-selector-parser 6.1.4
entries.impact: Prototype-pollution, CSS injection, parser CPU exhaustion and renderer denial-of-service exposures in untrusted document content.
entries.mitigation: Upgrade or override to mermaid >=11.16.1, katex >=0.18.2 and postcss-selector-parser >=6.1.5 with renderer regression tests; keep alerts visible until then.
entries.recheckCondition: Lockfile versions meet patched ranges and rendering/fixture tests pass on the exact PR head.

unclassifiedPolicy.action: Treat any unmatched live Dependabot alert as an unclassified security blocker. Do not dismiss it.
